Pipeline stage: technical report

Source: R/pipeline-report.R
pipeline_report.Rd

Writes the HTML technical report for a calibrated pipeline: everything mv_report() shows (summary, model fit, items, graphics, scores, item health cards), plus a Pipeline decisions section with the stages, every flag and its status, the decision log with notes, and the rules in effect, and a Groups section with score summaries by group. The reproducibility section lists the pipeline code that was run.

Usage

pipeline_report(
  p,
  file = "pipeline-report.html",
  title = p$title,
  author = NULL,
  open = interactive() && !isTRUE(getOption("mirtverse.dry_run")),
  ...
)

Arguments

p

a calibrated pipeline from calibrate().

file

path of the .html file to write.

title

report title; defaults to the pipeline title.

author

optional author line.

open

logical; open the report in a browser afterwards.

...

further arguments passed to mv_report(), such as cards.

Value

The pipeline, invisibly, with the reporting stage recorded. The report path is stored in p$report.

Details

Before writing, the report gate checks one thing (threshold from mv_rules()):

  • small_group (block): a group with fewer than min_group_n respondents. Its summary is left out of the report so that individuals cannot be identified.

Flags from earlier stages that are still open are listed in the report as open.

Examples

# \donttest{
p <- add_responses(mv_pipeline("Certification exam"), certexam, items = 3:34,
                   key = certexam_key, group = "language")
p <- calibrate(p, model = "3PL")
#> Warning: Calibration is running with 1 block open flag(s) from earlier stages:
#>   #1 [block] possible_miskey: Q14 (p = 0.18, item-total r = -0.23)
#> Flags only warn because strict = FALSE. See flags(p).
p <- pipeline_report(p, file = tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
#> Warning: Reporting is running with 3 block and 4 review open flag(s) from earlier stages:
#>   #1 [block] possible_miskey: Q14 (p = 0.18, item-total r = -0.23)
#>   #2 [block] not_converged: test (not converged)
#>   #3 [review] local_dependence: Q21 & Q22 (Q3 = 0.28)
#>   #4 [review] parameter_range: Q14 (a = -0.71)
#>   #5 [review] parameter_range: Q21 (c = 0.62)
#>   #6 [block] dif_large: Q09 (MH D-DIF = -2.01, French vs English (favours English))
#>   #7 [review] dif_moderate: Q27 (MH D-DIF = -1.04, French vs English (favours English))
#> Flags only warn because strict = FALSE. See flags(p).
# }
